notes.title: Update 5.0.929
notes.content: [p]Match simulation updates :[/p][list][*][p]Smarter Game Plans: Winrate has been greatly rebalanced for more tactical diversity and fairer outcomes.[/p][/*][*][p]Sharper Lobs: Lobs are now more effective and rewarding when used at the right moment.[/p][/*][*][p]Faster, Shorter Rallies: Say goodbye to endless exchanges, the game features now more dynamic points![/p][/*][*][p]Speed Boost Upgraded: Quicker movement boosts your chances of chasing down tight shots![/p][/*][*][p]Topspin Depth Fixed: More accurate ball placement for realistic rally construction.[/p][/*][*][p]Serve speeds now better reflect a player's attributes: no more unexpectedly slow serves with good stats.[/p][/*][/list][p]Other updates :[/p][list][*][p]match: qualifier matches can now have a public [img src="https://statics.teams.cdn.office.net/evergreen-assets/personal-expressions/v2/assets/emoticons/smile/default/30_f.png?v=v83"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]infrastructures: the impact of sub-infrastructures on infrastructure levels has been rebalanced (infrastructure level up are easier at low levels, and harder at high levels) *[/p][/*][/list][p]Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]editor mode: attribute could have a +1 to their value (round issue)[/p][/*][*][p]objectives: the board was asking to upgrade infrastructure to level 10 whereas the max is 9. If you are impacted by this issue, you have to reach the end of the current season and the board will not ask you this again.[/p][/*][*][p]staff: the Board Director of Florida Academy was leaving his job after the first season whereas he is a permanent staff of the academy *[/p][/*][*][p]match: an useless shadow was displayed next to the net on the indoor stadiums[/p][/*][*][p]fantasy court: the behaviour and the animations of the game plans were shifted[/p][/*][*][p]tournaments categories names: there was an inconsistency in the category names between what was indicated for each tournament and the drop-down lists used for filtering *[/p][/*][*][p]Minor UI and texts fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][i]*: fixes only available for new careers created from this version[/i][/p]

[*] Match simulation : modification of service during matches and quick matches. Players self-adjust their risk according to their first serve percentage during the match, but also according to the level of risk in the game plan.

[*] Crash in calendar: there was a crash in week 47 if during the career creation you started to create your player and changed your mind and coaching an existing player

[*] the manager photo was not imported correctly if imported more than once
[*] Mirra Adrejeva had records 'in the future'*
[*] reduction of a flickering effect on certain stadium elements
[*] minor localization fixes
[/list]
Updates:
[list]
[*] extrem difficulty : less extrem but still the hardest 
[*] minor improvement in the understanding of simplified tactics
[*] add missing physics on some haircuts
[/list]
Optimization:
[list]
[*] improved memory management of 3D assets: can improve game stability on some devices
[/list]
 
*: fixes only availble for new career created from this version

notes.title: Hotfix 5.0.793
notes.content:
Thank you very much for welcoming TM25.
We've had your initial feedback, we're sorry for any problems you've encountered, and here's a first batch of fixes.
Enjoy the game!

Major fixes:
[list]
[*] Using editor mode for players incorrectly modified data, in particular the turned pro date, which could then lead to errors and inconsistencies in tournament inscriptions
[*] Pro team players were abnormally refused entry to tournaments
[*] players : 15 players were corrupted in the database and could cause an error if they were in your pro team
[/list]
 
Other fixes:
[list]
[*] player creation : radar chart is now updated with the player size during the creation or the edition of a player
[*] fantasy court : player photo after edition or import cas sometimes reseted and not taken into account
[*] mac only : the size of the game was unusually large (unnecessary files)
[*] texts : some tournaments categories had a wrong name
[*] match simulation : correction of players' reaction time when lobbed
[*] game plans : sometimes a personnalised gameplan was not found and this caused an error at the start of a match
[/list]

Adds & Updates:
[list]
[*] New option in Settings>Graphics : Global illumination
[*] Minor update on players names
[/list]

[*] Pro team players were abnormally refused entry to tournaments
[*] players : 15 players were corrupted in the database and could cause an error if they were in your pro team
[*] player creation : radar chart is now updated with the player size during the creation or the edition of a player
[*] fantasy court : player photo after edition or import cas sometimes reseted and not taken into account
[*] mac only : the size of the game was unusually large (unnecessary files)
[*] texts : some tournaments categories had a wrong name
[*] match simulation : correction of players' reaction time when lobbed
[*] game plans : sometimes a personnalised gameplan was not found and this caused an error at the start of a match
